انتجعن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَجَعْنَ (intajaʕna) /in.ta.d͡ʒaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# اُنْتُجِعْنَ (untujiʕna) /un.tu.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# اِنْتَجِعْنَ (intajiʕna) /in.ta.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
